data.content: A collection of work for IPKO, the second largest mobile telephony in the country, during 2013-2022.

Ipko is one of the largest telecommunications companies in Kosova, and is growing fast in Europe. Over the years it has brought various offers to our market, trying to meet the telecommunication needs of individuals and businesses. This year, this company asked us to realize a promotional advertisement for Pako PRO, a package targeting businesses. We produced a TV commercial with a very creative approach.

The ad was shot with the one-shot technique which is a famous technique used in movies but not usually used in our market, making this ad a novelty. The ad is very dynamic and positive which illustrates how much this business package facilitates work, where even a young leader can control a growing business with a click of fingers.

Largely anticipated 4G technology came with a bang, featuring the well known Kosovar female rally driver, telling the viewer how important speed is to her. Internet speed, rather, because the speed she gets when stepping the foot to the pedal just comes too easy for her.
We were asked to create a campaign promoting the IPKO Teams offer, which provided free usage for every employee within an organisation, as well as other perks, the bigger the team.
We came up with a TV commercial and other promotional channels, portraying small businesses with huge number of employees, taking advantage of the offer.
We also produced a smartphone game, getting users to catch as many pretzels, croissants and loaves of bread over a limited time, giving them minutes of calls and gigabytes of data for free.
A cute, low budget campaign for data roaming to the neighbouring countries, depicting a video game style entertainment one gets while travelling to the beach.
An integrated campaign for the most affordable package for kids, offering heaps of call minutes, sms and data for only 2 euros per month.
The first in the country to provide 3G technology, we created a campaign urging consumers to get the best out of it, not letting a moment go by without anything interesting to do on the internet.
